REMINDERS.messageGone: The original message has been deleted.

chat.title: Reminders
chat.mute: Turn off reminders for this actor
chat.unmute: Turn on reminders for this actor
chat.showAll: Show all reminders for this actor

manager.name: Stored reminders
manager.label: Manage reminders
manager.hint: List and remove the reminders stored for you.
manager.title: Stored reminders
manager.clearConfirm: This removes all your stored reminders and your on/off settings, and clears leftover reminders that older versions stored on actors. It cannot be undone. Continue?

enabled.name: Enable reminders
enabled.hint: Turn all reminder features off for you: the chat menu entry, the sheet bells and button, and the turn messages. Your stored reminders are kept.

itemTypes.name: Item reminder bells
itemTypes.label: Choose item types
itemTypes.hint: Choose which kinds of items get a reminder bell on actor sheets.
itemTypes.title: Item reminder bells
itemTypes.intro: Items of the ticked types get a reminder bell on actor sheets. Reopen open sheets to see the change.
itemTypes.excluded: Item types without a reminder bell

npcReminders.name: Reminders for NPCs
npcReminders.hint: GM setting. Turn on the reminder features for NPC actors: the bells on their sheets, the Reminders button, the combat tracker entry and their name in the chat menu. Off by default.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Print debug messages to the browser console.

trigger.toggle: Fires on: {trigger}. Click to choose another trigger.
